_note: TEACHES THE AGE LADDER. Won by gathering 500 food AND reaching age 2, the Age of Embers.
THE OBJECTIVE AND THE MESSAGE ARE THE OWNER'S OWN WORDS, 2026-09-02. The food row is
new with them, and it needed a new SUBJECT: the five that existed counted units,
buildings and ages, and none of them could express a resource at all. `resource` reads
SimPlayer.stock and names its kind in `id` (food/wood/gold/stone).
⚠️ THESE TWO ROWS ARE NEVER TRUE ON THE SAME TICK, AND THAT IS WHY A WIN ROW LATCHES.
Advancing to age 2 costs EXACTLY 500 food (ages.json) and AdvanceAgeCommand deducts it
when the advance STARTS -- so the food row is true at the moment the player can afford
the age, and false from the instant they buy it, 100 ticks before the age they bought
arrives. Multiple win rows are ANDed. Evaluated live, this scenario would have shipped
UNWINNABLE WHILE LOOKING COMPLETELY CORRECT, which is exactly what the owner already
caught in scenario 3's '0 enemy units on map'. ObjectiveSystem therefore treats an
objective list as a CHECKLIST: a win row that has ever been satisfied stays satisfied
(SimPlayer.objective_done, one-way like `defeated`). A ticked line does not untick,
which is also what the player already believes is happening.
SO 'GATHER 500 FOOD' MEANS 'HOLD 500 FOOD AT SOME POINT', which is precisely what the
overview below tells the player to watch for. Cumulative gathering would be a new
per-player running total in the sim, on the wire and in state_hash() -- see
ObjectiveSystem._stock_of, which records that the current answer is a choice.
THE FOOD ROW IS NOT REDUNDANT even though the age costs the same 500. It is what makes
the FIRST HALF of the lesson legible: the player is told to watch a counter climb, and
the tracker (15.6) can tick that half off before the age is bought. Without it the
scenario is a single row that stays blank for several minutes.
THE AGE ROW NAMES NO id. `subject: age` counts nothing on the map -- it reads
SimPlayer.age -- so an id here would be meaningless and the loader refuses one rather
than ignoring it. THE VALUE IS THE AGE INDEX, NOT A COST: ages are indexed from 1, so
`>= 2` is 'has advanced once'.
STARTS AT AGE 1 for the obvious reason: a scenario about advancing an age cannot start
in the age it is asking you to reach. `starting_age` is one number for everybody, so
the passive opponent starts there too.
name: How To Age Up
description: A new age unlocks better buildings and better units. Gather enough to advance from the Age of Ash into the Age of Embers.
message:
Objective: Gather 500 food, and advance to the Age of Embers.

Overview: Select 3 of the villagers and have them gather food from berry bushes, have 1 villager gather wood from a tree, and have the last villager gather stone from a rock.

On the top right of the screen are your resource counters -- watch the food icon until it ticks up to 500. Then tap the gold AGE icon at the top centre of your screen to age up. The ring around it shows how long the advance has left.
